chapters.title: Chapter 1568 The Escaped Immortal’s True Appearance
paragraphs: 1568 The Escaped Immortal's True Appearance
However, as much as Kelan wanted Yuan to defeat the Immortal, he still expected Yuan to lose the fight.

"Although you've been doing good so far, the Immortal still has one more trick up their sleeve. This trick is what differentiates and truly separates mortals and immortals." Kelan muttered after seeing how much Yuan was dominating the Immortal.

'This is outrageous! Why does such a mortal exist in a place like the Fourth Heaven?! If only I weren't injured by the pursuers, I could've killed him in seconds instead of being ridiculed like this!' The Immortal cursed inwardly.
They had been chased nonstop since escaping the Nine Heavens Eternal Grotto and were injured in the process. If it weren't for their injury, Yuan wouldn't have been able to push the Immortal so far.
'This mortal... should not exist! His existence is extremely dangerous! Even if I have to sacrifice my life in the process, I will get rid of him!'
Several hours later, the Immortal's aura suddenly changed, causing their surroundings to freeze.
From spiritual energy to the Purple Sea, everything was still, as though time itself had frozen.
'This pressure!' Yuan halted his movements after sensing this familiar aura.
He excitedly smiled and said, "It's about time you use Immortal Qi. I was wondering when you'd use it."
"I hate to admit this, but to force an immortal like me to use Immortal Qi on you, a mortal, is an unprecedented feat that I must respect."
As the immortal spoke, the mist around them began dissipating, revealing their true appearance for the first time.
Yuan's eyes widened with surprise when he saw the Immortal, who was much smaller than he'd anticipated.
"A child?" Yuan muttered in a daze as his gaze stared at the little boy floating before him.

The Immortal's true form was revealed to be that of a small boy, seemingly no older than ten years. Of course, the immortal wasn't a real child but merely bore the appearance of one. Adding to the strangeness, a short white tail protruded from his back.
"As a show of respect, I shall fight you in my true form," said the Immortal.
"You... you're not human?" Yuan asked him with a strange frown.
"Do I look human to you? I am of the proud Misty Fox race." The Immortal responded in a boastful tone.
"Haa..." Yuan sighed with a genuinely disappointed look on his face. He'd gone out of his way to fight this immortal because he thought they were human.
However, now that the Immortal is revealed to be a beast, it would no longer count toward his Unique Quest, even if he were to defeat the Immortal.
The Immortal misunderstood Yuan's reason for disappointment and roared, "Are you looking down on me because of my appearance?! This is why I refuse to show myself!"

Despite saying such words, the Immortal had to reveal himself mainly due to his injury. Concealing himself required a significant amount of energy, and he wouldn't be able to maintain it for much longer if he also had to use Immortal Qi on top of that in such a state.
In the end, the Immortal decided to throw away his defenses to focus solely on his attack power.

Yuan shook his head and said, "No, I am not looking down on you. I thought you were human, hence why I even bothered to fight you. Now that I know you're a beast, I don't really have a reason to continue fighting you."
"What kind of bullshit is that?! You disturbed my recovery and forced me to reveal myself! We're going to fight to death even if you don't want to!" The Immortal shouted.
"I never planned on backing out of our fight, anyway." Yuan smiled.
"There won't be any fight! I am going to massacre you now!" The Immortal roared before activating a technique using Immortal Qi instead of normal Qi.
"Immortal White Lance!"
The same technique from before was now multiple times stronger, and since they were created from Immortal Qi, Yuan would not be able to destroy them even using Dragon's Soul.

Furthermore, the Immortal Qi being exuded by the Immortal made it much more difficult for Yuan to move, and his entire body was screaming from pain. In fact, his muscles were being torn apart every passing second. He was essentially a sitting duck at this moment in time.
Seeing this, Kelan prepared to save Yuan.
However, despite his seeming perilous situation, Yuan did not panic.
"Die, you monster!" The Immortal gestured, causing hundreds of Immortal White Lances to rain upon Yuan.
Yet, Yuan refused to move, much less dodge the incoming attack.
"Has he given up on living?! Fool!"
Not daring to wait until it was too late, Kelan made his move, disappearing from his spot.
A split second later, Kelan appeared in front of Yuan, who was slightly surprised by this sudden intruder.

However, before Yuan could speak or take any action, Kelan released an overwhelming aura that far surpassed the Immortal and destroyed all of the Immortal's attacks with a mere flick of his arm, treating them like they were mere candle flickers.
The Immortal's entire body trembled in fear when he sensed Kelan's profound presence.

Unlike the Immortal, who had traversed to the Fourth Heaven illegally, Kelan received approval, so his cultivation wasn't as suppressed as the Immortal. However, the Immortal was sure he would not be this newcomer's opponent even if they had similar cultivation.
Ignoring the Immortal, Kelan turned to look at Yuan with a proud demeanor around him.
"Why did you give up at such a crucial moment, Junior? Even if you are certain of your death, as a man, you should fight until your last breath. Who knows? Maybe a miracle could've happened."
Kelan expected Yuan to thank him for saving his life. Yet, Yuan had a frown on his face.
He removed the Celestial Visage so Kelan could see his frown and said coldly, "Who said I gave up? And who the hell are you? Who permitted you to interrupt our fight?"
"Huh?" Kelan muttered in a surprised tone, his expression puzzled.

sentences.text: 1568 The Escaped Immortal's True Appearance
However, as much as Kelan wanted Yuan to defeat the Immortal, he still expected Yuan to lose the fight.
"Although you've been doing good so far, the Immortal still has one more trick up their sleeve.
This trick is what differentiates and truly separates mortals and immortals." Kelan muttered after seeing how much Yuan was dominating the Immortal.
'This is outrageous!
Why does such a mortal exist in a place like the Fourth Heaven?!
If only I weren't injured by the pursuers, I could've killed him in seconds instead of being ridiculed like this!' The Immortal cursed inwardly.
They had been chased nonstop since escaping the Nine Heavens Eternal Grotto and were injured in the process.
If it weren't for their injury, Yuan wouldn't have been able to push the Immortal so far.
'This mortal... should not exist!
His existence is extremely dangerous!
Even if I have to sacrifice my life in the process, I will get rid of him!'
Several hours later, the Immortal's aura suddenly changed, causing their surroundings to freeze.
From spiritual energy to the Purple Sea, everything was still, as though time itself had frozen.
'This pressure!' Yuan halted his movements after sensing this familiar aura.
He excitedly smiled and said, "It's about time you use Immortal Qi.
I was wondering when you'd use it."
"I hate to admit this, but to force an immortal like me to use Immortal Qi on you, a mortal, is an unprecedented feat that I must respect."
As the immortal spoke, the mist around them began dissipating, revealing their true appearance for the first time.
Yuan's eyes widened with surprise when he saw the Immortal, who was much smaller than he'd anticipated.
"A child?" Yuan muttered in a daze as his gaze stared at the little boy floating before him.
The Immortal's true form was revealed to be that of a small boy, seemingly no older than ten years.
Of course, the immortal wasn't a real child but merely bore the appearance of one.
Adding to the strangeness, a short white tail protruded from his back.
"As a show of respect, I shall fight you in my true form," said the Immortal.
"You... you're not human?" Yuan asked him with a strange frown.
"Do I look human to you?
I am of the proud Misty Fox race." The Immortal responded in a boastful tone.
"Haa..." Yuan sighed with a genuinely disappointed look on his face.
He'd gone out of his way to fight this immortal because he thought they were human.
However, now that the Immortal is revealed to be a beast, it would no longer count toward his Unique Quest, even if he were to defeat the Immortal.
The Immortal misunderstood Yuan's reason for disappointment and roared, "Are you looking down on me because of my appearance?!
This is why I refuse to show myself!"
Despite saying such words, the Immortal had to reveal himself mainly due to his injury.
Concealing himself required a significant amount of energy, and he wouldn't be able to maintain it for much longer if he also had to use Immortal Qi on top of that in such a state.
In the end, the Immortal decided to throw away his defenses to focus solely on his attack power.
Yuan shook his head and said, "No, I am not looking down on you.
I thought you were human, hence why I even bothered to fight you.
Now that I know you're a beast, I don't really have a reason to continue fighting you."
"What kind of bullshit is that?!
You disturbed my recovery and forced me to reveal myself!
We're going to fight to death even if you don't want to!" The Immortal shouted.
"I never planned on backing out of our fight, anyway." Yuan smiled.
"There won't be any fight!
I am going to massacre you now!" The Immortal roared before activating a technique using Immortal Qi instead of normal Qi.
"Immortal White Lance!"
The same technique from before was now multiple times stronger, and since they were created from Immortal Qi, Yuan would not be able to destroy them even using Dragon's Soul.
Furthermore, the Immortal Qi being exuded by the Immortal made it much more difficult for Yuan to move, and his entire body was screaming from pain.
In fact, his muscles were being torn apart every passing second.
He was essentially a sitting duck at this moment in time.
Seeing this, Kelan prepared to save Yuan.
However, despite his seeming perilous situation, Yuan did not panic.
"Die, you monster!" The Immortal gestured, causing hundreds of Immortal White Lances to rain upon Yuan.
Yet, Yuan refused to move, much less dodge the incoming attack.
"Has he given up on living?!
Fool!"
Not daring to wait until it was too late, Kelan made his move, disappearing from his spot.
A split second later, Kelan appeared in front of Yuan, who was slightly surprised by this sudden intruder.

However, before Yuan could speak or take any action, Kelan released an overwhelming aura that far surpassed the Immortal and destroyed all of the Immortal's attacks with a mere flick of his arm, treating them like they were mere candle flickers.
The Immortal's entire body trembled in fear when he sensed Kelan's profound presence.
Unlike the Immortal, who had traversed to the Fourth Heaven illegally, Kelan received approval, so his cultivation wasn't as suppressed as the Immortal.
However, the Immortal was sure he would not be this newcomer's opponent even if they had similar cultivation.
Ignoring the Immortal, Kelan turned to look at Yuan with a proud demeanor around him.
"Why did you give up at such a crucial moment, Junior?
Even if you are certain of your death, as a man, you should fight until your last breath.
Who knows?
Maybe a miracle could've happened."
Kelan expected Yuan to thank him for saving his life.
Yet, Yuan had a frown on his face.
He removed the Celestial Visage so Kelan could see his frown and said coldly, "Who said I gave up?
And who the hell are you?
Who permitted you to interrupt our fight?"
"Huh?" Kelan muttered in a surprised tone, his expression puzzled.

chapters.title: Chapter 1569 Distraction
paragraphs: 1569 Distraction

Kelan was rendered speechless by Yuan's response, and after a moment of silence, he spoke, "Junior, it's good to be confident in yourself, but you were clearly on the brink of death. If I hadn't saved you just now, you'd have become a human skewer."
"Also, if you hadn't given up, why were you frozen just now? Any onlooker would've assumed you were giving up in that situation." Kelan said.
Yuan shook his head and sighed, "While I appreciate your thoughtfulness, it was unnecessary and undermined my existence. Leave. I don't need your assistance."
"You..." Kelan's expression quickly turned angry. He couldn't believe he was being lectured by the very person he had just saved.
"Is that so! Then you can go ahead and die here, you stubborn and arrogant little bastard!" Kelan left the scene the very next moment.

However, Kelan didn't wholly leave and only pretended to do so. Even if Yuan refused his goodwill and shooed him away, he still had a duty to protect Yuan, and it was not only his promise to Elder Bai that compelled him to do so.
Yuan's talent was simply shocking and unlike anything he'd seen before, and that fact alone was worth his protection.

'Regardless of his character, he's a profound existence that will significantly benefit our Celestial Overlord in the future. However, he'll need to survive until then, and with his suicidal nature, it's not going to be easy keeping him alive.' Kelan sighed inwardly, feeling like an older brother trying to keep his younger siblings out of trouble even though he was hated by them.
Meanwhile, the Immortal was left speechless by what had just transpired.

'W-who the hell was that bastard just now?! I don't recognize him, and since he left without doing anything to me, it's safe to assume that he's not with the pursuers!' The Immortal swallowed nervously.

If Kelan had been with his pursuers, he would've never made it to the Fourth Heaven alive. That was just how vast the difference in their strength was. Immortals are prideful creatures, so for one to acknowledge their inferiority held great significance.
"I apologize for that." Yuan suddenly said.
"What?" The Immortal stared at him with wide eyes.
"That man's interruption. Although it was never my intention, he disturbed our battle. Go ahead and use that technique again. I can even wait for you to recover some of your energy." Yuan explained.
Not just the Immortal, but even Kelan was utterly speechless.
After a moment of silence, the Immortal began trembling, his face flushed red, turning into a tomato.
"STOP MOCKING ME, YOU BASTARD! DO I REALLY APPEAR THAT PATHETIC TO YOU?!"
With an enraged bellow, his aura skyrocketed.
Meanwhile, several individuals far away from the Purple Sea sensed the distinct aura of the Immortal's Qi.
"It's the escapee!"
"Why are they releasing so much Immortal Qi?! Are they engaged in battle with another immortal?!"
"It must be the others! But why didn't they notify me?! They know that Immortal isn't someone they can handle alone!"

The immortals chasing after the escaped immortal were puzzled when they were not notified, and when they contacted the others, they were shocked to learn that none of them were actually fighting the escaped immortal.
"What? None of you are fighting the escapee?! Then what's with this immense Immortal Qi?! They wouldn't release so much Immortal Qi for no reason!"
"Maybe the escapee is trying to lure us into a trap."
"Do you seriously believe that?"
"Whatever the escapee is attempting, we need to capture or kill them! Let's hurry up before they escape our grasp again!"
These immortals immediately started soaring toward the Purple Sea.
At the same time, Bai Ning was just minutes away from reaching her destination.
Unlike Kelan, Yuan could sense her approaching presence from miles away. Not wanting to expose his identity so quickly, he wore the Celestial Visage again, hiding his face.
Just as Bai Ning arrived, the Immortal activated his technique again.
"Immortal White Lance!"
Thousands of white lances filled the sky, each exuding profound Immortal Qi.
Bai Ning was shocked by the scene, but when she noticed the masked man in the middle of the battlefield, her eyes fixed on him, and she was unable to look away.
"It's him!" she exclaimed in a bewildered voice.
Although he was wearing a different mask, she recognized him as the individual who bullied Bai Xutao and used that weird technique on her.
Bai Ning wanted to approach Yuan, but he was in a position where she could not enter, as she risked getting blown away with him by the Immortal.
"DIE FOR ME, YOU HUMAN MORTAL!"
The Immortal released his technique.
Kelan gritted his teeth as he watched Yuan being bombarded with Immortal Qi. He wanted to believe in Yuan, but his instincts acted before he could even think.
However, he was immediately halted by an unfathomable presence that surpassed even Senior Bai.
"Who's there?!" Kelan frantically looked around but couldn't sense anyone.
'To avoid my detection, they must be a God Ascension Realm expert! What the hell is going on right now?!' he cried inwardly.
"Oh no! Junior!"

The distraction rendered Kelan unable to save Yuan, his mind already racing to formulate excuses for when he would have to report Yuan's death to Senior Bai. Yet, Kelan's face filled with disbelief as he witnessed the unfolding events. What he saw defied all expectations and left him momentarily paralyzed in astonishment.

The Immortal's attacks landed with unerring precision, each strike tearing holes through Yuan's body. Yet, to the Immortal's astonishment, the grievous injuries Yuan sustained healed instantly, akin to a demon's heaven-defying regenerative abilities. It was as if the very laws of nature bent to keep Yuan whole.
[Progress: 15%]
[Progress: 17%]
[Progress: 20%]
The merging of his physiques, which had been progressing at a snail's pace, began to advance rapidly under the immense stress Yuan's body was enduring.
"Just what the fuck are you?!?" the Immortal shrieked out loud, his face twisted in anger, but his eyes showed a hint of fear.

chapters.title: Chapter 1571 Heaven Refining Immortal Physique
paragraphs: <You have acquired the title 'An Evolved Physique'>
<You have acquired the title 'Physique Merger'>

Yuan inspected his body after acquiring the Heaven Refining Immortal Physique. His body was incomparably stronger than before, whether in strength or durability. If his body couldn't handle the Immortal's attacks previously, his current body would have no problem shrugging them off.
The difference was akin to comparing dried mud to steel. There were also several other changes that occurred within his body, but he had no idea what they could be for the time being.
"Don't move, you demon!" A loud voice with a hint of terror suddenly resounded, snapping Yuan out of his daze.
He shifted his head to look at the person who'd just spoken—one of the pursuers.
"What did you just call me?" Yuan raised an eyebrow.

"There's no use hiding it! That ridiculous regenerating ability is unique to demons!" Yuan was speechless, but he didn't blame this individual for mistaking him for a demon. After all, he would've probably done the same if he were in that man's shoes, as his regenerating ability was acquired through Demon Cores, so the pursuers weren't wrong.
"I understand your confusion, but rest assured, I am not a demon." Yuan calmly said.
"Shut up! Do you think I'm stupid or something?!"
The pursuers outright ignored the Immortal, whom they had been chasing for months, to focus on Yuan, who was a much bigger threat to the Nine Heavens than the escapee.
"I don't think you're stupid... for now. If I were a demon, I would have horns and a crystal, wouldn't I?" Yuan exposed his torso so show that he had no demon crystal on his body.

"You're definitely taking me for a fool! High-ranking demons don't have horns and crystals! They look no different than humans!" "So you're suggesting that I am a Demon Emperor who looks no different than humans? How could a Demon Emperor be a mere Spirit King? And why would I bother to risk exposing myself to fight that immortal?" Yuan asked.
The pursuer couldn't find a logical explanation immediately and momentarily became speechless.

"You're obviously hiding your cultivation! There's no way a Spirit King could emit Immortal Qi! I don't know why you're fighting with the escapee, but that doesn't prove you're not a demon!" One of the pursuers exclaimed.
"That's right! You're a demon hiding in human skin!" Another joined.

Seeing how the group of immortals prepared to kill him, Yuan sighed, "You guys must be quite weak if it requires four of you to chase after a single escapee. Come, I'll play with you." The group of immortals immediately exploded with anger after being provoked by Yuan.
"If we can't capture him, kill him!"
"Kill me? Even though I'm a demon? You should probably get the Demon Sealing Clan instead." Yuan laughed out loud.
The immortals' faces flushed red before surrounding him in a formation.
"Golden Lotus Prison!"

The four of them worked together to quickly create a powerful formation around Yuan. Although they were only Tier 5 Array Masters, they were able to create a Tier 6 formation in the blink of an eye together.
Yuan suddenly found himself entrapped inside a golden lotus that slowly drained his spiritual energy.
When Kelan saw this, he thought about intervening, but he wanted to see how Yuan would deal with this situation first. As long as Yuan's life wasn't in danger, he decided to remain as a spectator.
However, with Yuan's regenerating ability rivaling demons, Kelan was no longer worried that he might die.

The immortals, aware that their chances of killing Yuan were slim despite the disparity in their cultivation, resorted to using a formation specifically designed to capture entities as resilient as Yuan.
"Do you want me to destroy the formation for you?" Yu Ning, who had been silently watching this entire time, suddenly spoke.
"No, it's fine. I want to test out my new physique." "Okay..."
Yuan suddenly closed his eyes and took a deep breath.
The very next moment, the prison around Yuan suddenly began breaking down, almost as if it were slowly being devoured by an invisible force.
"W-what the fuck?!"
"The formation's losing energy!"
"That's impossible!"
"T-that demon bastard is absorbing the formation's Immortal Qi!"
"What?! How is he doing that?! Techniques are sealed within the Golden Lotus Formation!"
"It must be one of his demon abilities!"
"H-hey! Escapee! Help us kill this demon, and we'll give you freedom!" One of the immortals turned to look at the escapee.
"Are you serious? Even if I want to kill him, you saw for yourself that I am unable to do so." The Misty Fox said.
"That's only if you're fighting alone! If the five of us work together, there's still a chance!"
The Misty Fox couldn't reject the possibility of freedom and agreed to help the immortals.
"The more the merrier." Yuan smiled.
<Your understanding of Immortal Qi has significantly increased!>
After consuming Immortal Qi directly, Yuan's understanding of Immortal Qi skyrocketed, causing the Immortal Qi he exuded to become more apparent and profound.
'This is the perfect opportunity for me to understand Immortal Qi.' Yuan found a reason to fight these immortals.
The five immortals, each restricted to the Divine King, began bombarding Yuan with techniques infused with Immortal Qi.
To Yuan, enduring these hits with his bare body felt like being struck with a sledgehammer. However, unlike before, it wasn't enough to destroy his body and merely bruise it.
<Your understanding of Immortal Qi has increased!>

Moreover, whenever their attacks struck Yuan, his Heaven Refining Immortal Physique would automatically absorb some of the Immortal Qi, weakening the force of their blows and strengthening his body even further.
Suddenly, Yuan's aura surged, and his Dantian expanded.
<You have absorbed enough Qi for a breakthrough!>
<You have met the requirements for a breakthrough!>
<You have reached First Level Spirit Emperor!>
Amid the battle, Yuan had a breakthrough and finally escaped Spirit King, becoming a Spirit Emperor!

chapters.title: Chapter 1572 Spirit Emperor
paragraphs: The moment Yuan's cultivation entered Spirit Emperor, his aura surged so much that the immortals thought he'd skipped several levels in his breakthrough.
"This bastard had a breakthrough in the middle of a battle! What a fucking monster!"
"Wait... does that mean he was actually only a Spirit King...?"
The realization that Yuan, merely a Spirit King, possessed the prowess to fight them struck quickly. Their faces filled with terror as the full implications of his power dawned on them.
"W-we cannot let him live, or he'll become an immense threat to humanity later!"
"Kill him! Use everything you've got!"
The immortals frantically attacked Yuan, viewing him as a looming calamity destined to destroy humanity in the future.
Meanwhile, seeing Yuan breakthrough snapped Bai Ning out of her daze, and she suddenly approached the battlefield.
"Stop!" she shouted, her voice filled with commanding authority.
"Who the hell are you?!"
"Are you this demon's accomplice?!"
The immortals immediately became even more nervous. If Bai Ning turned out to be another demon, they'd have no chance of killing them.
However, Bai Ning retrieved a white and black medallion before throwing it at one of the immortals.
"That is my identity!"
"This is... the Heavenly White Tiger Clan's medallion? And this name... you must be the Heavenly White Tiger Goddess!" "Are you here to help us subjugate this demon?! Thank the heavens!"
However, Bai Ning shook her head and said, "No, but I want to fight him, so get out of my way."

"W-what? I understand that you want to fight him, but why must you do it alone? He's a dangerous entity—a demon that terrorized our world and all living beings within!" "Do I really have to explain myself to you?" Bai Ning narrowed her eyes at them.
The immortals exchanged nervous glances with each other. Bai Ning's status was simply too exalted for them to ignore, but it was not as though they could let her fight the demon alone.
If she died, they would be held responsible, hence their perplexed situation.
Seemingly aware of their predicament, Bai Ning said, "Don't worry, even if I die, you won't be responsible."
Bai Ning no longer paid attention to the immortals and approached Yuan, who hovered there calmly.
Without an ounce of fear in her eyes, Bai Ning spoke, "Yo. Do you remember me?"
Yuan nodded, "You're the one who interrupted my fight with Bai Xutao."
"You call that a fight? You were straight bullying my brother." "Do you know why I did what I did?" Yuan then asked.
"No, and I don't care. The only thing that matters to me is you attacked someone from my family."
"So you won't care even if he slaughters an entire city of innocent people?" Yuan asked, his voice carrying a hint of coldness.
After a moment of silence, Bai Ning responded, "He will atone for whatever crime he'd committed, just like how you'll be punished for attacking a member of the Heavenly White Tiger Clan."
"Is that so? What if the Immortal Monarch were in my shoes? What would you do then?"
Bai Ning was taken aback by his sudden mention of the Immortal Monarch.
"How dare you utter his sacred name with your dirty mouth?! The Immortal Monarch would never be in your shoes in the first place!"
"Really? The world's a big and mysterious place. What if I turn out to be the real Immortal Monarch?" Yuan teased.
"Blasphemy!" Bai Ning bellowed before suddenly transforming, her aura skyrocketing.

"I couldn't kill you in the Third Heaven because of my restricted cultivation, but it's a different story up here! Let's see if you can repeat what you did last time!" Bai Ning's aura surged all the way to the peak of Divine King, surpassing the other immortals' aura.
"This lad is not bad..." Kelan nodded in approval after sensing Bai Ning's powerful aura.
"No matter how high your cultivation is, you'll never be able to defeat me." Yuan casually shook his head.
"Shut up and fight me!" Bai Ning shouted as she started her assault.
Yuan didn't move to purposefully test the strength of her first strike.
Sha!

Bai Ning used her bare hands—her claws—to strike. Imbued with powerful Immortal Qi, her claws were strong enough to cut through Yuan's body. However, the damage was only superficial, and it didn't take more than a second for it to recover fully. "Not bad, I suppose." Yuan calmly commented.
"Shut up and fight me seriously!" Bai Ning shouted.
"Are you actually using Bai Xutao as an excuse to fight me? All you need to do is ask nicely, you know."
Bai Ning responded with another powerful strike, its pressure powerful enough to cleave the Purple Sea.
Five red lines resembling sword cuts spread across Yuan's chest but disappeared in the blink of an eye.
Despite Bai Ning's relentless attack, Yuan remained still, seemingly unwilling to fight her.
"FIGHT ME, DAMN IT!" she roared, her aura surging even higher.
"Not until you admit that you don't care about the punishment and are only using it as an excuse to fight me." Yuan casually shrugged.
"Fuck you!" Bai Ning continued launching powerful strikes at Yuan.
Several moments later, her most potent attack managed to slice his body in half, but it was pointless and just a waste of Immortal Qi if she couldn't kill him.
"I'm waiting..." Yuan yawned, positioning himself as if he were lazily lying on a couch before a television.
Yuan's unwillingness to fight and his blatant mockery infuriated Bai Ning.
"Fuck! Fuck! Fuck!"

Bai Ning stopped fighting for a moment and cursed out loud. "I don't care about Bai Xutao or the punishment for attacking a member of our Heavenly White Tiger Clan! I just want to fight you!" she exclaimed with her face flushed red.
"That's more like it. Don't you feel better just from being honest with yourself?" Yuan chuckled.
"Fuck you! If you still refuse to fight me properly, I'll make you regret being born!" she roared.
"I am a man of my word..." With Number One Under Heaven in his grasp, Yuan suddenly charged at Bai Ning.
Seeing this, Bai Ning prepared to confront him with a wide grin on her face.

chapters.title: Chapter 1573 Beyond Human Capabilities
paragraphs: When Yuan swung Number One Under Heaven at her, Bai Ning prepared to confront it with her claws, which were sharper and more durable than even Mythic-grade treasures. However, moments before they clashed, her instincts kicked in, causing her to avoid the sword instead.
Sha!
A powerful sword light swung past Bai Ning's claw and struck the Purple Sea behind her, splitting it in half.
Although the sword light didn't touch her, its aura grazed her hand, and that was enough to cut through her skin.

Bai Ning swallowed nervously at this and cried inwardly, 'If I hadn't avoided his sword at the very last moment, my entire hand would've been cut off! I have never seen such a powerful Soul Weapon before!' Seeing Bai Ning's nervous expression, Yuan looked at Number One Under Heaven and showed a bittersweet smile, "You're too powerful."
After pondering for a moment, he put away the sword and retrieved Dragon's Soul again.
"What is the meaning of this? Are you looking down on me?" Bai Ning's brows deeply furrowed.
"I mean, it's not like I am trying to kill you." Yuan calmly said.

"Do you really think you have what it takes to kill me?! You're thinking too highly of yourself just because you manage to fight with a few ordinary immortals! Today, I, Bai Ning, shall teach you what a prodigy is like!" Bai Ning roared before charging at Yuan, releasing a relentless assault on him.
Yuan parried all her attacks, but the impact from her strikes was far stronger than those of all the immortals combined, enough to push him back.
'So it wasn't just his sword that contributed to his prowess! This bastard must have a unique physique that rivals demons!' Bai Ning gritted her teeth as she used all her power, which she rarely did.
Hours passed, but Bai Ning couldn't see any opportunity to defeat Yuan. He was akin to an unsurmountable wall—one that could regenerate any damage in the blink of an eye.
'Is he really a demon?!' Bai Ning began doubting whether he was actually a demon.

Although she had never fought or seen a demon before, she'd heard plenty of rumors about them, especially how they terrorized the world with their god-like healing abilities—the same one Yuan was displaying at this moment.
"Are you really a demon?!" Bai Ning asked without stopping the fight.
"What do you think?" Yuan casually responded.
"I think your healing abilities are ridiculous!" "Thanks." "I am not complimenting you! It's so ridiculous that it's not helping your case!"

Yuan chuckled and said, "People will believe what they want to believe regardless of the facts, even if it's right in their eyes. There's no need to try to convince these people, as I would only be wasting my breath."
"You will regret this in the future!"
"Are you worried about me? If so, thanks." Yuan chuckled.
"Shut up!"

Several more hours later, Bai Ning ran out of spiritual energy. Usually, she'd be able to fight for months, if not years, without exhausting her spiritual energy, but she had to use a tremendous amount of spiritual energy just to hurt Yuan.
Meanwhile, Yuan was still full of energy from absorbing her attacks, transforming it into his own energy.
"How... are you... still so full of energy?!" Bai Ning was in disbelief.
"I just am. Anyway, it's been fun, but I have other things to do."
"Where do you think you're going?!" One of the immortals shouted at him.
Yuan fell silent and glanced at him through his mask.
After a moment of silence, Yuan suddenly withdrew Number One Under Heaven and charged at the immortal with his movement technique.
[Immortal Rendering Sword Strike!]
The immortal was caught off guard by Yuan's surprise attack and failed to react in time before being sliced in half.
However, the immortal didn't die and managed to survive with just his soul. Yet, Yuan swung his sword again, using nothing but his Enhanced Sword Aura.
"Nooo!"
The immortal cried out loud, his voice filled with fear.
Unfortunately, Yuan didn't spare another thought before cutting down his soul, killing him entirely.
Ding!
<You have achieved an impossible feat by defeating a Cultivator that was at least nine realms above you!>
<You have acquired the title 'Beyond Human Capabilities>
[Beyond Human Capabilities: When fighting a Cultivator, your base stats will be boosted by 100%]
[Defeat a Cultivator who is at least nine realms above you without using Heaven's Supremacy]
[Completed]
With two of the most challenging tasks completed, Yuan felt like he was making progress for Heaven's Supremacy.
"What the fuck have he done?!" Kelan was greatly shocked by Yuan's actions.
In fact, nobody there expected Yuan to suddenly kill one of the immortals there.
"YOU SON OF A BITCH!" The other immortals quickly reacted to the death of their companion, their faces flushed with anger. Yet, none of them dared to attack Yuan.
"You will regret this, you damn demon!"
Instead of fighting him, the immortals turned around and ran away.
As for the Misty Fox, he also ran away. Kelan appeared shortly after with a deep frown on his face.
"You... why did you do that?" he asked.
Yuan looked at him and calmly responded, "Why not?"

"That man you killed belonged to the Nine Heavens Law and Order! Not only do they oversee the Nine Heavens Eternal Grotto, but they're also responsible for keeping order in the Nine Heavens! Their influence is second to the Celestial Emperor! And you just killed one of them!" "Is that so? I got unlucky, I guess."
Kelan suddenly turned to look at Bai Ning and said, "Can you please leave us alone?"
"And who the hell are you to command me?" Bai Ning frowned.
Kelan's body suddenly released an oppressive aura that filled the entire Purple Sea.
"Please leave... while I am still asking nicely." "..." Bai Ning narrowed her eyes at him.
After a moment of silence, she turned to look at Yuan and spoke, "This isn't over. I'll defeat you the next time we meet!"
Bai Ning left the scene shortly after, leaving Yuan and Kelan alone in the middle of the Purple Sea.

After a moment of silence, Yuan suddenly withdrew Number One Under Heaven and charged at the immortal with his movement technique.
[Immortal Rendering Sword Strike!]
The immortal was caught off guard by Yuan's surprise attack and failed to react in time before being sliced in half.
However, the immortal didn't die and managed to survive with just his soul.
Yet, Yuan swung his sword again, using nothing but his Enhanced Sword Aura.
"Nooo!"
The immortal cried out loud, his voice filled with fear.
Unfortunately, Yuan didn't spare another thought before cutting down his soul, killing him entirely.
Ding!
<You have achieved an impossible feat by defeating a Cultivator that was at least nine realms above you!>
<You have acquired the title 'Beyond Human Capabilities>
[Beyond Human Capabilities: When fighting a Cultivator, your base stats will be boosted by 100%]
[Defeat a Cultivator who is at least nine realms above you without using Heaven's Supremacy]
[Completed]
With two of the most challenging tasks completed, Yuan felt like he was making progress for Heaven's Supremacy.
"What the fuck have he done?!" Kelan was greatly shocked by Yuan's actions.
In fact, nobody there expected Yuan to suddenly kill one of the immortals there.
"YOU SON OF A BITCH!" The other immortals quickly reacted to the death of their companion, their faces flushed with anger.
Yet, none of them dared to attack Yuan.
"You will regret this, you damn demon!"
Instead of fighting him, the immortals turned around and ran away.
As for the Misty Fox, he also ran away.
Kelan appeared shortly after with a deep frown on his face.
"You... why did you do that?" he asked.
Yuan looked at him and calmly responded, "Why not?"
"That man you killed belonged to the Nine Heavens Law and Order!
Not only do they oversee the Nine Heavens Eternal Grotto, but they're also responsible for keeping order in the Nine Heavens!
Their influence is second to the Celestial Emperor!
And you just killed one of them!" "Is that so?
I got unlucky, I guess."
Kelan suddenly turned to look at Bai Ning and said, "Can you please leave us alone?"
"And who the hell are you to command me?" Bai Ning frowned.
Kelan's body suddenly released an oppressive aura that filled the entire Purple Sea.
"Please leave... while I am still asking nicely." "..." Bai Ning narrowed her eyes at him.
After a moment of silence, she turned to look at Yuan and spoke, "This isn't over.
I'll defeat you the next time we meet!"
Bai Ning left the scene shortly after, leaving Yuan and Kelan alone in the middle of the Purple Sea.

chapters.title: Chapter 1574 Nine Heavens Law and Order
paragraphs: Once they were finally alone, Kelan raised his hand and showed his faction's symbol, as long as his rank.

Yuan's curiosity was piqued at the sight of Kelan's symbol and rank. He raised an eyebrow and inquired, "What brings a high-ranking figure like you to the Fourth Heaven? I doubt it's a simple task like catching an escaped immortal."
Yuan pretended not to be part of the Celestial Overlord to see Kelan's reaction.
"There's no need to be on alert. My name is Kelan, and Senior Bai asked me to watch over you because he was worried that your fight with the immortal might go awry."
"Oh, is that so? I apologize if I had offended you in any way before, Senior." Yuan's attitude suddenly changed, becoming more respectable.
This dumbfounded Kelan.
'The way he treats his friends and foes are so vastly different. Even if I am someone slightly suspicious, he might not hesitate to cut me down.' Kelan thought to himself.

"Anyway, even though nothing happened to you, and you even managed to slay an immortal—albeit the wrong one—I must apologize for failing to save your life multiple times due to how absorbed I was in your fight."

"Your fight was truly mesmerizing and awe-inspiring. Unfortunately, you ended up killing someone you shouldn't have, and you even made it seem like you're a demon... or are you actually one?" Kelan inquired, seemingly unclear on his identity.
Yuan smiled and said, "Don't worry, I am definitely human."

Kelan sighed in relief and said, "Thank the heavens. You would've made things really difficult for us if you were a demon. With that said, you'll probably still be hunted by the Nine Heavens Law and Order for killing their member, and rumors about you being a demon will spread."

"Your healing abilities that rival a demon will concern many people, and they might treat you like a real demon, even if you're a human. However, the Celestial Overlords will do everything they can to protect you."

However, Yuan shook his head and said, "Don't worry, I never intended to cause trouble for the Celestial Overlords. Even if they want to find me, they don't know my real identity yet, so they'll be chasing a phantom for a while."
"You're unfathomably bold... Nobody could be as calm as you if they knew they were being hunted by the Nine Heavens Law and Order..."
Yuan shrugged and said, "Anyway, since I am safe, does that mean you'll return to the upper heavens now?"

"No, I'll stick around a little longer. After all, it's been so long since I visited the lower heavens. I also want to know more about you, Junior. And once you recover from your fight, let's have a spar."
Yuan nodded, "Alright."
"Then I'll see you later." Kelan left the scene shortly after, returning to Senior Bai to notify him of their situation.
Yuan returned to the Pavilion of Knowledge.
"Yuan! You're okay!" Xi Meili's face immediately brightened after seeing his return.
"I told you I'd be fine." Yuan smiled.
"How was it? Did you kill the immortal?" she asked.
"No, he got away, but I did kill an immortal." "What...?" Xi Meili raised her eyebrows in a puzzled manner.
"It's a bit complicated, but this is what happened..."
Yuan recalled the events that had occurred during his battle.
"Heavens... what a mess..." Xi Meili's eyes were wide open by the end.
Meanwhile, Kelan requested an urgent audience with Senior Bai.
When Senior Bai received this urgent request, his eyebrows rose.
Sometime later, he met up with Kelan, who was waiting for him inside his world.
"Senior." Kelan respectfully bowed to him.
"What's the matter? To request an urgent audience, did something happen to Yuan?" Senior Bai went straight to the point.
Kelan nodded with a serious expression and said, "A lot happened, so sit back and prepare yourself."
Senior Bai immediately swallowed nervously.
"I watched our Junior fight the escaped immortal. It was quite something. He exceeded my expectations in every metric and more. This is how it went..."
While Kelan recalled everything he had witnessed to Senior Bai, the same thing was happening elsewhere with the group of immortals that had confronted Yuan.
"It's a demon, I tell you! We must contact the Demon Sealing Clan and the Demon Sealing Grotto as soon as possible!"
"This demon was unlike anything I've seen or heard! He wielded a sword and spear and had the aura of a beast!"
"He was only a Spirit King, but he could use Enhanced Sword Aura and fight several Divine Kings simultaneously!"
The leader of Nine Heavens Law and Order listened to the information with a confused and bewildered look on his face.

"A Spirit King that can fight an immortal with their cultivation suppressed to Divine King? Has demon-like regenerating ability? What kind of fucking creature are you guys making up? Did you guys get hit in the head too hard when trying to capture the escapee?" The leader couldn't believe what he was hearing. This entity sounded like something that wouldn't exist even in exaggerated fiction.
"This monster is real!" The immortals insisted.
The leader sighed, "Alright, I'll contact the Demon Sealing Clan and the Demon Sealing Grotto. Tell me everything that happened."
A few hours later, the leader of Nine Heavens Law and Order visited the Demon Sealing Faction's headquarters and requested an audience with Qian Chu, the current leader of the Demon Sealing Faction.
"It's been a while, Demon Sealer Qian." Qian Chu casually nodded and said, "I was told you have information on a powerful demon?"

"Unfortunately. My faction members encountered this demon in the Fourth Heaven while chasing after one of the Nine Heavens Eternal Grotto escapees. With that said, I am not certain this information is trustworthy. You'll understand what I mean in a bit."
"A demon in the Fourth Heaven? This would be troublesome if true." Qian Chu muttered.
"Alright, let's hear it. Tell me everything you know about this demon."

chapters.title: Chapter 1575 Unknown Demon
paragraphs: The leader of Nine Heavens Law and Order began recalling what his subordinates told him with a somewhat stiff expression, almost as if he couldn't believe what he was uttering.
"This demon was only a Spirit King when they initially encountered it but had a breakthrough toward the end, reaching Spirit Emperor."
"However, even before reaching Spirit Emperor, this demon could fight with the escapee, who was restricted to the Divine King realm, even overpower them to a certain extent."
"Once this demon reached Spirit Emperor, it was able to fight five Divine Kings simultaneously, even killing one of our members."

"This demon wielded two different weapons, a sword and a spear, being exceptionally proficient with the sword—to the point where he could use Enhanced Sword Aura. Moreover, both of these weapons were Soul Weapons."
"This demon's regenerating ability is also no joke, being able to recover within seconds after having their entire body annihilated."
"Not only did they have a ridiculously fast regenerating speed, their body was also incredibly durable."
"This demon wore a mask, but it had no visible horns or unique skin color, a common trait amongst demons. Furthermore, it had the aura of a beast."
"..." Qian Chu listened to the information of this potential demon with raised eyebrows.
He'd studied and encountered more than anyone within the Demon Sealing Clan, yet he'd never encountered a demon that could wield Soul Weapons, much less two.
While demons are naturally powerful and could fight humans with higher cultivation than itself, not even a Demon Emperor could fight someone eight realms stronger, let alone five at once.

The most ridiculous claim about this demon was that it could use Enhanced Sword Aura. Demons specialized in blood techniques and their own bodies, and there had never been a record of a demon using Sword Aura, much less Enhanced Sword Aura.

If Qian Chu had to be honest, he would outright refute these claims. However, there was no reason for the Nine Heavens Law and Order to fabricate such information, especially since their leader had personally shown up to share it. The details were simply too elaborate to be a joke.
"So, what do you think? Ridiculous, right?" The Nine Heavens Law and Order leader said with an embarrassed face.
"However, I have verified the information myself. My members have no reason to lie about this, and they looked genuinely shaken by their encounter with this demon."

Qian Chu quickly replied, "I would be lying if I said that I don't doubt such information, but if a demon with this sort of capabilities were to truly exist, our world would definitely be plunged into another chaotic era—perhaps one that's even more chaotic than the last one."

The Nine Heavens Law and Order leader swallowed nervously after hearing such words, and he said, "Regardless of if this entity is a demon or a ghost, we must find it and ensure that such a thing won't happen."
Qian Chu nodded and said, "I will have all of my Supreme Demon Sealers and Master Demon Sealers look into this demon."
"Thank you! I will also contact the Demon Sealing Grotto so we can work together. The sooner we deal with this threat, the better!"

Although the leader knew these two powers rarely collaborated and, more often than not, clashed with each other, they were not in a position to be picky. If this demon turned out to be the real deal, they might have another war with demons.
Qian Chu didn't object to the leader's idea to involve the Demon Sealing Grotto, knowing they would inevitably learn of the situation and intervene, regardless of the Demon Sealing Clan's stance.
The Nine Heavens Law and Order leader didn't linger and immediately went to the Demon Sealing Grotto.
Qian Chu also summoned all of the Supreme Demon Sealers and Master Demon Sealers to an urgent meeting, something that has not happened since he became the leader of the Demon Sealing Clan.
The demon sealers were taken aback by the sudden summoning. Filled with a mix of anticipation and a touch of dread, they swiftly assembled at the headquarters.

At the meeting, Qian Chu revealed the situation to the demon sealers, who responded with skepticism rather than shock or fear. "I know what you're all thinking, but the leader of the Nine Heavens Law and Order personally delivered this information to me. Regardless if this entity is a demon or something else, it raises too many concerns and must be looked into."
"Do we have a description of this demon?" Someone asked.
Qian Chu retrieved a large scroll and revealed a painting of Yuan on it.
"This was created by those who encountered the demon. It has all of the details they could recall. Study it and memorize it."

While the Demon Sealing Clan was having their meeting, the Demon Sealing Grotto was also preparing to hunt this demon. After hearing how ridiculously capable this demon was, they decided to make hunting it their number one priority.
Over the next few days, hundreds of powerful demon sealers would be sent to the Fourth Heaven.
Meanwhile, Senior Bai had trouble standing once Kelan recalled everything to him.

"Dear heavens... are you sure you weren't hallucinating? Yuan only became a cultivator a few years ago... How in heaven's name is he already fighting immortals? Even if their cultivation was suppressed, their experience should've made an insurmountable difference. Or are you telling me that he'd managed to acquire what others need tens of thousands of years to learn in just several years? Do such terrifying talents truly exist in this world?"
"Trust me, I know how you feel, and I witnessed it first-hand. He's the real deal—a real monster." Kelan sighed.
He continued, "What should we do now? Although the Nine Heavens Law and Order aren't aware of his identity now, they eventually will."

Senior Bai pondered for many minutes with a serious expression on his face before speaking, "I'll seek guidance from the Celestial Overlord. Don't utter a word of this to anyone else before I return."
"Naturally." Kelan nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 1576 Leaving the Pavilion of Knowledge
paragraphs: After he left, Senior Bai immediately sought an audience with Xu Jiaqi. Once they met, Senior Bai informed her of everything Yuan had done.

"He's already capable of fighting Divine Kings despite being only a Spirit King? I mocked him for his slow cultivation speed not long ago..." Xu Jiaqi wore an astonished expression on her beautiful face, something that rarely happened.
"Moreover, they're not ordinary Divine Kings, but real immortals with vast experience." Senior Bai sighed.
He continued, "Anyway, his monstrous talent is one thing. Killing a member of the Nine Heavens Law and Order is another. I'm afraid they might give him—us trouble in the future."
"About that... the Nine Heavens Law and Order have already acted." Xu Jiaqi suddenly said.
"What?" Senior Bai's eyes widened at this new information.
"The leader has already contacted the Demon Sealing Clan and Demon Sealing Grotto, and these two powerhouses have dispatched their experts," Xu Jiaqi explained.
"Isn't that really bad? What should we do?" Senior Bai asked.
Xu Jiaqi pondered for a moment before speaking, "We won't do anything until we need to. Let's just see where this goes."
"Are you sure? What if it's already too late by then?"
"Are you still underestimating Yuan after all this? He won't go down so easily, and we'll have more than enough time to react. Kelan will be with him, as well, no?"
Senior Bai nodded, "Kelan wishes to remain in the lower heavens a little longer."
"Permission granted. Make it his mission to protect Yuan, too. However, don't spoil him. Only act when absolutely necessary." Xu Jiaqi said.
"I understand."
"We also have a member within the Demon Sealing Clan. I'll notify him of the situation." Xu Jiaqi added.
Senior Bai nodded.
After talking a little longer, Senior Bai returned to Kelan to pass Xu Jiaqi's decision to him.
Meanwhile, the Nine Heavens went into turmoil after news that the Demon Sealing Clan and the Demon Sealing Grotto had dispatched most of their experts in some kind of expedition.
"Fuck, are we going to war with demons again?"
"No, they are looking for a single demon."
"What? They dispatched so many people for a single demon? Did they find the Demon Emperor that escaped previously?"
"Apparently, this one is even more dangerous."
"How long has it been since the Demon Sealing Clan's been this active?"
"It's been thousands of years... Unfortunately, their activity isn't something to be celebrated but dreaded."
Somewhere in the Demon Sealing Grand Library, a beautiful woman sat before a scroll with a ponderous face.
"I wonder how the founder's doing... Hopefully, I'll get to see him again soon." Yan Hara muttered to herself as she stared at the scroll with the demon's description.
As a Master Demon Sealer, she was also dispatched to the lower heavens.
Meanwhile, Yuan and Xi Meili spent several more hours at the Pavilion of Knowledge before leaving.
"Are you leaving already?" Xuan Kun asked them when he noticed them exiting the room.
"Yes, we've finished reading all of the materials." Yuan nodded.
"I see... I hope it was helpful to you."
"It was. I learned some new things about the Immortal Monarch and his companions—mostly about the Nine Divine Supremes."

"If you ever need information on anything, don't hesitate to visit our Pavilion of Knowledge. Here is our medallion. There are other 'Pavilion of Knowledge' in other places with different names, but they all serve the same purpose. Our Pavilion of Knowledge happens to be the first one to be founded." Xuan Kun handed him a purple medallion with an image of a pavilion and the word 'Knowledge' engraved into it.
"Thank you." Yuan accepted the medallion and tossed it into his spatial ring.

Xuan Kun shook his head and said, "No, I should be thanking you. Because of you, we know the Immortal Monarch is still alive out there somewhere. You have no idea how much this means to me—to many beast clans in the Nine Heavens." "What does it mean?" Xi Meili asked out of curioisty.
"Well, for starters, there will be a massive movement to find the Immortal Monarch soon." Xuan Kun revealed with a serious face.
Yuan raised an eyebrow and inquired, "And what will they do once they find him? The Immortal Monarch's era ended long ago."

"The Immortal Monarch's era may have ended, but some—many still revere him. He is akin to their god—a being above humans and beasts. His return will have unfathomable significance that I cannot even begin to comprehend." Xuan Kun spoke with a dazed look on his face.
"..." Yuan didn't know how to react to that and remained silent.
As they made their way downstairs, their presence caught Bai Ning's attention, who also appeared to be leaving.
"Where are you going after this?" Bai Ning asked him.
"I don't know." He shrugged.
"What about you?"
"I have to return to my family temporarily to report some things. Did you not notice the disturbance from earlier?" she asked with a raised eyebrow.
"I felt many powerful ripples, but I am not the type to stick my nose in other's business." Yuan replied with a smile.
"Good on you. It was a mess out there." Bai Ning sighed.
"Oh? What happened?" he asked with a curious face.
"A fight between immortals and some crazy bastard—the same bastard that beat my brother." Bai Ning clenched her fist as she recalled him.
"The masked individual? He was there? Did you avenge your brother?" Yuan asked with a worried face.
Bai Ning merely sighed at his question, her expression darkening with every passing moment.
"I see..." Yuan wore a look of understanding and didn't inquire further.
"Well, I hope you'll get to avenge your brother next time."
She vigoriously nodded, "I won't let him escape a third time!"
"Then I'll see you later."
After bowing to each other, Yuan left the Pavilion of Knowledge with Xi Meili, who tried hiding her face by looking away from Bai Ning.
Bai Ning stared at Xi Meili's back as she walked to the exit.
'She looks a little familiar... but from where?' she wondered inwardly.

Once they met, Senior Bai informed her of everything Yuan had done.
"He's already capable of fighting Divine Kings despite being only a Spirit King?
I mocked him for his slow cultivation speed not long ago..." Xu Jiaqi wore an astonished expression on her beautiful face, something that rarely happened.
"Moreover, they're not ordinary Divine Kings, but real immortals with vast experience." Senior Bai sighed.
He continued, "Anyway, his monstrous talent is one thing.
Killing a member of the Nine Heavens Law and Order is another.
I'm afraid they might give him—us trouble in the future."
"About that... the Nine Heavens Law and Order have already acted." Xu Jiaqi suddenly said.
"What?" Senior Bai's eyes widened at this new information.
"The leader has already contacted the Demon Sealing Clan and Demon Sealing Grotto, and these two powerhouses have dispatched their experts," Xu Jiaqi explained.
"Isn't that really bad?
What should we do?" Senior Bai asked.
Xu Jiaqi pondered for a moment before speaking, "We won't do anything until we need to.
Let's just see where this goes."
"Are you sure?
What if it's already too late by then?"
"Are you still underestimating Yuan after all this?
He won't go down so easily, and we'll have more than enough time to react.
Kelan will be with him, as well, no?"
Senior Bai nodded, "Kelan wishes to remain in the lower heavens a little longer."
"Permission granted.
Make it his mission to protect Yuan, too.
However, don't spoil him.
Only act when absolutely necessary." Xu Jiaqi said.
"I understand."
"We also have a member within the Demon Sealing Clan.
I'll notify him of the situation." Xu Jiaqi added.
Senior Bai nodded.
After talking a little longer, Senior Bai returned to Kelan to pass Xu Jiaqi's decision to him.
Meanwhile, the Nine Heavens went into turmoil after news that the Demon Sealing Clan and the Demon Sealing Grotto had dispatched most of their experts in some kind of expedition.
"Fuck, are we going to war with demons again?"
"No, they are looking for a single demon."
"What?
They dispatched so many people for a single demon?
Did they find the Demon Emperor that escaped previously?"
"Apparently, this one is even more dangerous."
"How long has it been since the Demon Sealing Clan's been this active?"
"It's been thousands of years...
Unfortunately, their activity isn't something to be celebrated but dreaded."
Somewhere in the Demon Sealing Grand Library, a beautiful woman sat before a scroll with a ponderous face.
"I wonder how the founder's doing...
Hopefully, I'll get to see him again soon." Yan Hara muttered to herself as she stared at the scroll with the demon's description.
As a Master Demon Sealer, she was also dispatched to the lower heavens.
Meanwhile, Yuan and Xi Meili spent several more hours at the Pavilion of Knowledge before leaving.
"Are you leaving already?" Xuan Kun asked them when he noticed them exiting the room.
"Yes, we've finished reading all of the materials." Yuan nodded.
"I see...
I hope it was helpful to you."
"It was.
I learned some new things about the Immortal Monarch and his companions—mostly about the Nine Divine Supremes."
"If you ever need information on anything, don't hesitate to visit our Pavilion of Knowledge.
Here is our medallion.
There are other 'Pavilion of Knowledge' in other places with different names, but they all serve the same purpose.
Our Pavilion of Knowledge happens to be the first one to be founded." Xuan Kun handed him a purple medallion with an image of a pavilion and the word 'Knowledge' engraved into it.
"Thank you." Yuan accepted the medallion and tossed it into his spatial ring.
Xuan Kun shook his head and said, "No, I should be thanking you.
Because of you, we know the Immortal Monarch is still alive out there somewhere.
You have no idea how much this means to me—to many beast clans in the Nine Heavens." "What does it mean?" Xi Meili asked out of curioisty.
"Well, for starters, there will be a massive movement to find the Immortal Monarch soon." Xuan Kun revealed with a serious face.
Yuan raised an eyebrow and inquired, "And what will they do once they find him?
The Immortal Monarch's era ended long ago."
"The Immortal Monarch's era may have ended, but some—many still revere him.
He is akin to their god—a being above humans and beasts.
His return will have unfathomable significance that I cannot even begin to comprehend." Xuan Kun spoke with a dazed look on his face.
"..." Yuan didn't know how to react to that and remained silent.
As they made their way downstairs, their presence caught Bai Ning's attention, who also appeared to be leaving.
"Where are you going after this?" Bai Ning asked him.
"I don't know." He shrugged.
"What about you?"
"I have to return to my family temporarily to report some things.
Did you not notice the disturbance from earlier?" she asked with a raised eyebrow.
"I felt many powerful ripples, but I am not the type to stick my nose in other's business." Yuan replied with a smile.
"Good on you.
It was a mess out there." Bai Ning sighed.
"Oh?
What happened?" he asked with a curious face.
"A fight between immortals and some crazy bastard—the same bastard that beat my brother." Bai Ning clenched her fist as she recalled him.
"The masked individual?
He was there?
Did you avenge your brother?" Yuan asked with a worried face.
Bai Ning merely sighed at his question, her expression darkening with every passing moment.
"I see..." Yuan wore a look of understanding and didn't inquire further.
"Well, I hope you'll get to avenge your brother next time."
She vigoriously nodded, "I won't let him escape a third time!"
"Then I'll see you later."
After bowing to each other, Yuan left the Pavilion of Knowledge with Xi Meili, who tried hiding her face by looking away from Bai Ning.
Bai Ning stared at Xi Meili's back as she walked to the exit.
'She looks a little familiar... but from where?' she wondered inwardly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1577 A Hundred Million
paragraphs: Once Yuan and Xi Meili left the Pavilion of Knowledge, they disappeared into the Purple Sea. Bai Ning left shortly after and returned to her clan in the upper heavens to update them on the situation.
"Where are we going now?" Xi Meili asked Yuan as they soared across the Purple Sea.
"A place that will allow me to kill a lot of magical beasts," he calmly said.
"Why?" Xi Meili raised an eyebrow.

Although divine beasts and magical beasts are beasts, magical beasts are typically simpleminded and instinct-driven animals mutated through spiritual energy, so divine beasts don't feel anything even if magical beasts are slaughtered. In fact, divine beasts often slaughter and consume magical beasts, which is akin to humans cultivating with spirit stones and monster cores.
"I need to kill a hundred million entities..." he sighed.
"A hundred million?!" Xi Meili's jaw dropped at this astonishing number that would take years of constant grinding.
"I would love to ask why you'd need to kill so many, but I'm a little afraid to do so..." Xi Meili swallowed nervously.
Yuan chuckled and said, "You just asked. Anyway, it's a quest—something I need to do to become stronger."

"You're already powerful enough to kill immortals. I cannot imagine how much more powerful you can become." "No, I am not powerful enough to kill immortals. I only managed to kill that one because his cultivation was restricted. If I had to fight him at full power, he'd easily kill me." Yuan shook his head at reality.
"Still, I don't think anyone else out there can boast of defeating someone nine realms above their own strength."
"With so many experts from the upper heavens showing up, I will need to become strong—much stronger if I want to protect you and everyone." A glint of determination flickered within Yuan's eyes.
"We could've asked Xuan Kun, but we had already left the Pavilion of Knowledge." Xi Meili then said.

"It's fine. I intend to return to the others first. We can figure out the rest afterward." After returning to the Cultivators' Haven, where Meixiu and the others are in seclusion, Yuan said to Xi Meili, "You can return to training if you want. I'll be away for a few days." "I've had enough training for now. I'll take a look around the city while I wait for your return," she said.
Yuan nodded, "Stay safe."
She chuckled, "Don't worry, I doubt many Bai Xutao are out there." Yuan logged off the next moment.

Once he returned to Earth, Yuan went to relax inside the bathroom by soaking in medicine. Even though the medicine no longer had any effect on his body, it still felt better than an ordinary hot bath.
After getting out of the bathroom, Yuan noticed a card placed on the desk beside the bed.
He picked it up and read its contents.
[Chairman Lee has contacted us on... The Great Battlefield has finished with its renovations and will resume Faction Wars soon. Our Faction War with Fiery Garden of Hell has been scheduled.]
"Two days ago, huh? Luckily, I finished my business in Cultivation Online earlier, or I would've missed the Faction War," he mumbled to himself.
The Demon Sealing Faction and Fiery Garden of Hell was scheduled to begin in three days.
He went to the training grounds to see if anyone was there, but it was empty.
Everyone was busy with their training in Cultivation Online.
With nothing else to do, Yuan went to the balcony and started playing the zither to pass the time.
A few hours later, Meifeng knocked on the door.
"You can enter."
Meifeng walked straight to the balcony and said, "You saw the note, right?"
"Yes."
"Do you really intend to fight the Faction War alone?"
"Yes, but I'll need you there to be the ruler," he calmly nodded.
"Of course, I'll be there."
"I'll make my way to the Eternal Lotuses now. I'll see you at the Great Battlefield."
Sometime later, Yuan disappeared into the clouds, speeding toward the Eternal Lotuses' headquarters.

When he arrived, the guards at the entrance instantly recognized him and said, "Our leader is expecting your arrival, Player Yuan." Yuan followed one of them inside and was led directly to Bai Lianhua's room.
"Welcome, Yuan. I've been anticipating your match since Miss Meifeng told me about it two days ago." Bai Lianhua greeted him with a bright and beautiful smile.
"If I was any slower with my business in Cultivation Online, I would've missed it and disappointed you." Yuan smiled.
"But you didn't. Anyway, Yu Rou is in her room."
Yuan nodded.

"Ah, before you go to her, I'd like to thank you again for all your help. The resources you've given us greatly benefited every member of our faction, and our faction's prowess skyrocketed in a short time." "That was the purpose to begin with. Maybe you'll be able to get your revenge on the Fiery Locust Swarm soon."

Bai Lianhua's eyebrows suddenly raised, and she said, "Unfortunately, that may no longer be possible, as the Fiery Locust Swarm had been disbanded after their rank was stripped and their leader and a majority of their members had been banned from participating in further Faction Wars for using drugs during their match with the Demon Sealing Faction."
"Oh, right. I forgot they did something like that." Yuan chuckled.
"Fiery Queen and her faction also faced ridicule since the Fiery Locust Swarn was under them." Bai Lianhua added.
"So they must be extra pissed off right now. This is great. It'll make our match even more entertaining."
Yuan left to meet with Yu Rou shortly after.
The following day, Yuan traveled to the Great Battlefield with Yu Rou and Bai Lianhua.

When he arrived, Meifeng was already waiting for him—alongside the other members of the Demon Sealing Faction. This time, every member was present. However, none of them would be participating in the Faction War and were there as mere spectators.

chapters.title: Chapter 1578 Fighting the Fiery Garden of Hell
paragraphs: "I was really hoping you didn't show up so we could have some fun," Wang Ming remarked as Yuan and his group arrived.
"Sorry, but I really need to do this alone," Yuan said with an apologetic smile.
"It's fine, but we have the next one!"
"Of course."
As they made their way to the arena, their group drew the attention of everyone they passed, like a group of celebrities.
"Look! The Demon Sealing Faction is finally here!"
"It looks like their entire faction will be present for this Faction War!"
"That's only natural. They're against the Fiery Garden of Hell, after all. Even Player Yuan won't be able to fight so many players alone." "Who knows? With the new changes, anything's possible."
"No, it'll definitely be much more difficult for Player Yuan if everyone can use deadly techniques."
"I'm sure Player Yuan has some ridiculously powerful attacks that can wipe out thousands of players in the blink of an eye."
"Even if that's the case, I doubt he would be able to use those techniques too much before running out of Qi."
The people speculated and debated on their Faction War, unaware that Yuan was planning to fight the Fiery Garden of Hell alone.
Meanwhile, the Fiery Garden of Hell was already gathering inside the new and improved arena.
The arena was expanded several times its original size, and hazardous areas, such as a river of real lava and deadly traps, were spread throughout it.
The arena itself could easily accommodate ten million players at once, so there was plenty of room for even the largest factions to go wild.
Due to the formation that prevents death and serious injuries, the technique evaluation was no longer required, making Faction Wars more accessible and exciting.

A record number of people showed up to spectate the Faction War between the Demon Sealing Faction and the Fiery Garden of Hell, not to mention the number of people watching from home and other places.
At this moment, more than half of the world tuned in to watch the Faction War—to see how the Demon Sealing Faction would deal with the Fiery Garden of Hell and its impressive number of players.
"I've been waiting for you, Yuan!" Chairman Lee's face brightened like a lightbulb after seeing Yuan and the rest of the Demon Sealing Faction.
"Do I have to do anything before we can start the Faction War?" Yuan asked.
"No, we can start once it's time." Yuan nodded and said, "Then I'll make my way to the arena."
"Good luck, brother." Yu Rou said to him.
The others followed, but Chairman Lee's eyebrows raised when the Demon Sealing Faction also started saying it.
Seeing Chairman Lee's puzzled face, Wang Ming said, "Only Yuan will be participating in the Faction War. We're just here as spectators."
"W-what?! You intend on fighting the Fiery Garden of Hell alone?! All 600,000 of them?!" Chairman Lee's eyes widened with shock as he asked Yuan.
"Yes, I do." Yuan calmly acknowledged.
"B-but... that's..." Chairman Lee was at a loss for words. He couldn't imagine how someone could fight so many people at once—not even someone like Yuan.
Yuan smiled and said, "There's a reason I created the formation. Of course, I wanted to make Faction Wars safer for everyone, but it's also so I can fight with fewer restrictions."
Chairman Lee still couldn't find any words.
Yuan continued walking to the exit, quickly disappearing from the waiting room. Meifeng followed him since she had to be the ruler.
"He's serious?" Chairman Lee uttered in a dazed voice.
"He never jokes around in these sorts of situations." Wang Ming chuckled.
Sometime later, Yuan appeared in the arena. When the spectators saw this, the entire stadium erupted with cheering.
However, the cheering quickly quieted once the spectators realized only two members from the Demon Sealing Faction were present.
"Huh? Where's the rest of the members?" Someone asked out loud.
"Maybe they couldn't show up, just like the last Faction War?"
"That's impossible. I saw the entire Demon Sealing Faction at the airport. They're definitely here."
"So where the hell are they? The match's about to begin in ten minutes."
"L-look over there! The rest of the Demon Sealing Faction members are in the spectator's area!" Someone suddenly shouted, his arm pointed at a specific location in the stadium meant for VIPs.
"No way... they're here as spectators? Does this mean Player Yuan wants to fight the Fiery Garden of Hell alone?! That's crazy!"
"Hahaha! His arrogance knows no bounds!"
"Are the Fiery Garden of Hell aware of this?"
"We'll find out soon."

Yuan, who showed up alone in the arena to face the Fiery Garden of Hell, shocked every spectator watching. Nobody knew what he was trying to achieve or what his thought process was, but many people were mad.
"Fuck! I can't believe I woke up early for this shit!"
"I can't believe I actually bet money on the Demon Sealing Faction's victory! What was I thinking?!"

After realizing that Yuan planned to fight the Fiery Garden of Hell alone, many people became desperate. They gambled the rest of their money on the Fiery Garden of Hell's victory, hoping to recoup some of their losses.

Meanwhile, Fiery Queen had someone scout the arena using a scouting technique. "What? Only Player Yuan is on the field, excluding the ruler?" Fiery Queen couldn't believe what she was hearing and had the scouter do it again.
Yet, the scout reconfirmed that Yuan was alone.
"That bastard actually dares to face us alone? How much does he intend to look down on me?!" Fiery Queen gritted her teeth in anger instead of feeling relieved that he was alone.
Five minutes before the match, a familiar voice resounded through the broadcasting speakers.
"Hello, everyone! It's me, Yan Xiaoxiao, and I will be the commentator for this Faction War!"
"Before we start, I would like to announce that the highly anticipated 'Demon Sealing Faction Interview' will be released after this Faction War is concluded, so stay tuned for that!"
